The '''Nouane system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Allied Region|region]] of [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]]. The system contained the eponymous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]], which served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the region since the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when the area was a thriving mini-[[Empire (disambiguation)|empire]].

==Description==
The Nouane [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]], an [[Allied Region]] of 212 [[Star/Legends|star]] systems located in the area of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]. The system's most important [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the world also named [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]], which had served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the region since its days as one of the countless mini-[[Empire (disambiguation)|empires]] found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the early years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
Since the early days of the Republic, approximately [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], the Nouane system&mdash;and the planet Nouane in particular&mdash;served as the heart of the eponymous region, which had become a bustling empire of 212 star systems located near the northeastern edge of the Inner Rim. Gradually, over time, the Republic expanded across the galaxy, enveloping the comparatively small government. Though the region was not a member of the Republic, [[minister]]s from the Nouane system held considerable power on various worlds within the galactic government.<ref name="Atlas" />

Thousands of years later, the nomadic [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors raged a [[Mandalorian Wars|crusade]] against the Republic. They launched a series of attacks into Republic space from their [[Mandalore/Legends|homeworld]] in [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]], and one of their [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] invasion routes passed directly through the Nouane system. As a result, the warriors [[Battle of Nouane|conquered]] the regional capital. The beleaguered Nouanese people called upon the Republic for assistance, and once the Mandalorians were driven away, Nouane space joined the Republic as a semi-autonomous Allied Region. The region would enjoy this status through the end of the Republic and the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Once the Empire was defeated, the Nouane region again declared its independence.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nouane system, along with the planet that shares its name, first appeared in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
